title: Concept: SQLite statement built from an interpolated string in swift — review required
description: In swift, sqlite3_exec runs a statement assembled with string interpolation. Interpolation has no escaping step, so a value containing a single quote terminates the literal and the rest is parsed as SQL. The C API will happily execute multiple statements separated by semicolons.
applicability: swift apps that use the SQLite C API directly.
risk: Query manipulation and data disclosure; HIGH severity.
